Consider the following PR description:
QueryWith function returns empty query when ToSql succeeds

#### Description

The `QueryWith` function is returning empty queries when the `ToSql()` method succeeds, causing SQL queries to not execute properly.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```go
package main

import (
    "database/sql"
    "fmt"
    "github.com/Masterminds/squirrel"
    _ "github.com/lib/pq"
)

type mockDB struct{}

func (m *mockDB) Query(query string, args ...interface{}) (*sql.Rows, error) {
    fmt.Printf("Query executed: %s\n", query)
    return nil, nil
}

func main() {
    db := &mockDB{}
    
    // Create a simple select query
    query := squirrel.Select("test")
    
    // This should execute the query but doesn't
    rows, err := squirrel.QueryWith(db, query)
    if err != nil {
        fmt.Printf("Error: %v\n", err)
    }
    
    // Expected: "Query executed: SELECT test"
    // Actual: Nothing printed (query not executed)
    
    fmt.Printf("Rows: %v\n", rows)
}
```

When running this code, the query should be executed and printed, but instead nothing happens because the QueryWith function returns early when ToSql() succeeds instead of when it fails.
</pr_description>
